Entei

Fire

Johto · Generation 2 · Legendary Pokémon

Entei is a Fire-type Volcano Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 2.1 m tall and weighs 198 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is HP (115), with a base stat total of 580.
